data.body:
[P2] Include the previously selected fatal when combining callback failures

If output serialization records fatal `F`, owned `shutdown()` throws another fatal `G`, and the final `isShutdown()` query rethrows `F`, this call suppresses `F` beneath `G`. The outer finalizer then suppresses `G` beneath the previously selected `F`, creating `F → G → F`. The resulting cyclic diagnostic graph can break recursive error reporting. Include `priorFailure` when aggregating executor callback failures and avoid back-references to the selected fatal. Add a regression where the final state query repeats the serializer fatal after a different shutdown fatal.
